seo.title: CHUWU 初·五 — Scent, Balanced by the Five Elements
seo.description: CHUWU (初·五) creates fragrance guided by Bazi and the Five Elements — discover the scent your elemental balance is missing, or shop signature blends for love, wealth, career, health and harmony.

hero.eyebrow: Inspired by Five Elements, Rooted in Balance
hero.title:
Fragrance, Tuned to
Your Elemental Balance
hero.lede: CHUWU reads your Bazi (八字) to reveal which of the Five Elements — Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water — your chart is missing, then translates that insight into scent. Build a fragrance around what you lack, or choose a signature blend crafted for a specific intention.

philosophy.title: Five Elements, One Story
philosophy.body: Wu Xing (五行) describes the five forces — Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water — that circulate through every birth chart. Most people carry more of some and less of others. CHUWU exists to gently restore what's missing, one note at a time.

steps.title: Share Your Birth Details
steps.body: Enter your date and time of birth. We calculate your full Bazi — the Four Pillars of your chart.

steps.title: Discover What You Lack
steps.body: We tally your Five Elements and identify which are underrepresented, with recommendations for Love, Wealth, Career, Health and Overall Balance.

steps.title: Build or Choose Your Scent
steps.body: Compose your own top, middle and base notes from the elements you need — or pick a premade blend from the Shop.
